nodes.description: Library of helper functions used by MakerDAO executive spells; declares constants WAD and RAD.
Library function that sets the surplus auction bump amount on the protocol.
Library function that configures DC-IAM auto-line parameters for an ilk.
Library function that sets the minimum vault amount (dust) for an ilk.
Virtual function returning whether office-hours restriction is enabled; defaults to true.
External entry point executed by DssExec; guarded by the limited modifier and calls actions().
Virtual function that subclasses override to place all spell actions.
Modifier enforcing weekday and office-hour window using block.timestamp.
Forwards the officeHours() query to the spell action contract.
Computes the earliest valid cast timestamp, adjusted for office hours.
Initializes pause address, description, expiration, action, sig and tag.
Schedules the spell by computing eta and calling pause.plot().
Executes the scheduled spell via pause.exec() after setting the done flag.
Override that disables office hours for this spell by returning false.
Spell body performing the three protocol parameter updates via DssExecLib.
Deploys DssSpellAction and initializes DssExec with description, 30-day expiration and action address.
Public timestamp at which the spell becomes executable.
Public encoded function signature 'execute()' used by the pause proxy.
Public flag indicating the spell has already been cast.
Immutable codehash of the spell action, used to bind the spell to its code.
Immutable address of the spell action contract.
Immutable timestamp after which the spell can no longer be scheduled.
Immutable reference to the MCD_PAUSE contract used for plot/exec.
Public human-readable description of the spell.
Constant Changelog contract used to resolve protocol addresses.
Constant description string containing the executive vote hash.
Internal reference to the deployed DssSpellAction instance.
Constant 10**3 used for scaling parameter values.
Constant 10**6 used for scaling parameter values.
Miner-influenced block timestamp used for scheduling, expiration and office-hour checks.
Weekday and hour window check derived from block.timestamp in the limited modifier.
Arithmetic assignment eta = now + pause.delay() in schedule().
External call pause.plot(action, tag, sig, eta) made in schedule().
External call pause.exec(action, tag, sig, eta) made in cast().
Timestamp arithmetic in nextCastTime adjusting castTime by days/hours/minutes/seconds.
External call log.getAddress('MCD_PAUSE') used to resolve the pause contract.
Inline assembly extcodehash of the spell action used to compute the immutable tag.
Privileged protocol parameter updates (surplus amount, dust, DC-IAM) performed in actions().
External call SpellAction(action).officeHours() made by DssExec to query the action contract.
Constructor parameter carrying the spell description string.
Constructor parameter carrying the spell expiration timestamp.
Constructor parameter carrying the spell action address.
Local return variable in nextCastTime holding the computed cast timestamp.
Local variable holding the weekday index in nextCastTime.
Local variable holding the hour of day in nextCastTime.
Local variable holding the minute in nextCastTime.
Local variable holding the second in nextCastTime.
Local weekday index computed inside the limited modifier from block.timestamp.
Local hour computed inside the limited modifier from block.timestamp.
Local variable receiving the extcodehash result in the DssExec constructor assembly block.
Local copy of the spell action address used in the constructor assembly block.

edges.reason: block.timestamp determines the weekday/hour window enforced by the limited modifier.
nextCastTime compares and adjusts against block.timestamp to derive the earliest cast time.
eta is computed as now plus the pause delay, mixing timestamp input with arithmetic.
castTime arithmetic is seeded from block.timestamp and shifted by day/hour/minute/second deltas.
DssSpell sets expiration to block.timestamp + 30 days, making the spell lifetime timestamp dependent.
The limited modifier gates external execution of DssAction.execute.
execute() invokes the overridable actions() function.
The limited modifier calls officeHours() to decide whether the time window applies.
DssSpellAction.actions overrides the virtual DssAction.actions implementation.
DssSpellAction.officeHours overrides the virtual base implementation.
actions() performs privileged protocol parameter changes that only governance execution should trigger.
Parameter update calls DssExecLib.setSurplusAuctionAmount.
Parameter update calls DssExecLib.setIlkAutoLineParameters.
Parameter update calls DssExecLib.setIlkMinVaultAmount.
schedule() makes an external call to pause.plot after writing eta, exposing the flow to re-entrant calls on the pause contract.
cast() sets done and then makes an external call to pause.exec, a state-write-then-call pattern.
The constructor makes an external call to the Changelog contract to resolve MCD_PAUSE.
cast() writes the done guard before the external call that follows.
The constructor executes inline assembly extcodehash to derive the tag.
The constructor stores the action address later used by officeHours().
DssExec.officeHours delegates to the external SpellAction(action).officeHours() call.
nextCastTime queries the spell action's officeHours() setting through an external call.
nextCastTime performs the timestamp arithmetic that adjusts castTime into the allowed window.
schedule() writes the eta state variable that controls when execution is allowed.
DssSpell constructor deploys DssSpellAction and assigns it to action_.
DssSpell constructor invokes the DssExec constructor with the spell parameters.
The stored action_ address is the contract queried by SpellAction(action).officeHours().
The pause address supplies the contract targeted by the plot call in schedule().
The pause address supplies the contract targeted by the exec call in cast().
The address returned by log.getAddress('MCD_PAUSE') is assigned to the pause state variable.
The _spellAction parameter is assigned to the action immutable state variable.
The _description parameter initializes the description state variable.
The _expiration parameter initializes the expiration immutable state variable.
The _spellAction parameter is the code subject of the extcodehash computation.
The _action local copy is used inside the assembly extcodehash block.
The _tag local receives the extcodehash result returned by the assembly block.
The computed codehash is stored into the immutable tag used to bind the spell.
The castTime local is incremented and decremented in the timestamp arithmetic of nextCastTime.
The weekday index feeds the castTime adjustment branches.
The hour value feeds the castTime adjustment branches.
The minute value is subtracted from castTime to normalize to 14:00 UTC.
The second value is subtracted from castTime to normalize to 14:00 UTC.
The weekday local participates in the require(day < 5) office-hours access check.
The hour local participates in the require(hour >= 14 && hour < 21) office-hours access check.
The timestamp guard is the body of the limited modifier that gates execution.
block.timestamp is the direct source of the weekday/hour values checked in the guard.
nextCastTime requires eta != 0 and compares it with block.timestamp.
schedule() requires eta == 0 and then assigns the newly computed eta.
schedule() restricts scheduling with require(now <= expiration), a timestamp-based access condition.
The description parameter string is stored in the public description state variable.
The constructor encodes 'execute()' into the sig state variable.
The constructor stores the spell action address in the action immutable.
DssSpell reads action_ metadata (description) to initialize its parent DssExec.

normalization_plan.reason: The _description parameter exists only to initialize the description state variable inside the DssExec constructor.
The _expiration parameter exists only to initialize the expiration immutable inside the DssExec constructor.
The _spellAction parameter is used only within the DssExec constructor for address assignment and codehash computation.
castTime is a return accumulator that exists only inside the timestamp arithmetic performed by nextCastTime.
The weekday local is derived from castTime and used only in the nextCastTime adjustment branches.
The hour local is derived from castTime and used only in the nextCastTime adjustment branches.
The minute local is derived from castTime solely to subtract it during normalization.
The second local is derived from castTime solely to subtract it during normalization.
The weekday local exists only inside the limited modifier's timestamp guard check.
The hour local exists only inside the limited modifier's timestamp guard check.
_tag is a temporary holding the extcodehash result produced by the constructor assembly block.
_action is a temporary alias of the action address used only inside the assembly extcodehash block.
